capabilities: Move selected text or links to a chosen heading in the file
Rank target headings by proximity using a Naive Bayes classifier
Classify target headings with LLMs such as gpt3.5
List target sections by their position when no classification is used
extras: Naive Bayes mode is recommended by the author and improves with use; roadmap lists a bulk classifier as not yet done.
problem: Obsidian offers no help deciding which existing section of a file a selected text or link belongs under, so organizing long files means scanning headings manually.

relations.evidence: Performs best when used with url-namer

summary: Text mover that suggests headings to move selected text or links under, ranked by Naive Bayes classification or LLM prediction.
